tasks.title: Lock regulated modality and activity perimeter
tasks.why: The application must match what Kinetic actually does in Brazil. A wrong modality cascades into capital, governance, contracts, reporting and the authorization forms.
actions: Map every Brazil-facing service and customer flow.
Classify each activity as intermediation, custody, exchange/FX-related or ancillary.
Document which services remain with Rules Holdings BVI and which Kinetic performs.
Obtain Brazilian counsel sign-off on the selected modality and any associated FX authorization request.
tasks.definitionOfDone: A signed scope memo identifies the SPSAV modality, regulated services, outsourced services and any separate authorization dependencies.
tasks.risk: Do not assume the legacy collecting-agent model maps cleanly into the SPSAV perimeter.

tasks.title: Build evidence that Kinetic was operating on 2 February 2026
tasks.involved: Compliance; Tax adviser; Operations; Fitbank relationship owner
tasks.regulatoryBasis: Res. 520 art. 88 transition regime; IN 704 transitional filing requirements
tasks.why: Only entities already carrying out the relevant activities at the regime's entry into force can rely on the transition route.
actions: Create a dated evidence inventory covering the period before and around 2 February 2026.
Collect customer transactions, contracts, bank/PIX records, invoices/accounting entries, tax reporting and operating records.
Write a short chronology explaining the Brazil operating model and continuity of activity.
Have counsel assess whether the evidence proves the specific regulated activities claimed.
tasks.definitionOfDone: Evidence room contains an indexed, counsel-reviewed record demonstrating eligible activity at the transition date.
tasks.risk: Weak evidence here can undermine eligibility for the transitional authorization route.

tasks.title: Complete Phase 1 Sisorf application package
tasks.regulatoryBasis: IN BCB 704/2026, applicable SPSAV authorization forms and documents
tasks.why: The filing is document-heavy. Treat the forms as outputs of underlying work, not as the work itself.
actions: Identify every Sisorf form and declaration applicable to the transition application.
Populate legal entity, controller, shareholder, administrator and activity data consistently across forms.
Cross-check names, CPF/CNPJ, ownership percentages and corporate records.
Run a line-by-line legal completeness review.
tasks.definitionOfDone: Every required Phase 1 form is complete, internally consistent, signed where required and mapped to an evidence index.

tasks.title: Controller and qualifying-holder declarations / access authorizations
tasks.regulatoryBasis: IN BCB 704 controller, control-definition and information-access declarations
tasks.why: BCB needs a clear, verifiable ownership and control picture and the necessary authorizations to validate relevant information.
actions: Prepare current ownership and control chart through ultimate beneficial owners.
Identify qualifying holders and controllers under the applicable authorization rules.
Collect required declarations concerning control arrangements and shareholder agreements.
Collect BCB/RFB information-access authorizations and required personal/corporate documentation.
tasks.definitionOfDone: All controller and qualifying-holder documents are signed, current and consistent with corporate records and the Sisorf filing.

tasks.title: Phase 1 legal QA, board approval and submission
tasks.involved: Brazilian counsel; Board; Finance; Corporate secretary
tasks.regulatoryBasis: Res. 520 art. 88; transition application deadline 30 October 2026
tasks.why: The statutory date is 30 October. The internal submission date is deliberately earlier to leave time for portal, signature or document defects.
actions: Freeze the evidence index and application pack on 20 October.
Obtain external legal QA with written critical-gap confirmation.
Run a submission dry run including access credentials, file sizes, signatures and portal permissions.
Obtain board/management authorization to file.
Submit by 27 October and archive protocol receipt plus the exact submitted package.
tasks.definitionOfDone: BCB filing is successfully protocolled no later than 27 October 2026 and the exact filed package is archived.
tasks.dependencies: All Before Phase 1 filing critical tasks
